title: Zoning map change for 108-05 68th Road, Forest Hills
summary: This application would change the zoning map for a site at 108-05 68th Road in Forest Hills, Queens, from R1-2A to R7A. It would allow a seven-story mixed-use building with about 38,900 square feet of floor area, including 33 apartments (eight income-restricted) and 11,500 square feet of community facility space.
